children: TOMI Environmental Solutions and Carbonium Core mutually agreed to terminate their Agreement and Plan of Merger, effective September 15, 2026. The decision followed TOMI’s review of its financial condition and strategy, and additional due diligence on Carbonium’s operations and expected performance. No termination fee is payable, and each party will cover its own expenses. TOMI expects to refocus resources on its current priorities.
